items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: And since you studied with him I thought that might have a bearing on your film writing that we’ll be discussing.

Well, it didn't actually, it really didn't not because – Stefan Wolpe was wonderful but I wasn't with him long enough to have him make a large – I moved from New York very quickly after I started studying with him. So, it wasn't really, you know a pivotal thing, like I was with him a year or two years or something like that.
